# CodeHS

> > CodeHS provides comprehensive K-12 computer science curriculum with state-aligned courses covering Python, JavaScript, Karel, web development, cybersecurity, and game design.

CodeHS offers standards-aligned computer science education for middle and high school students across multiple U.S. states. The platform features interactive courses using tools like Karel the Dog, Tracy the Turtle, p5.js, Unity, and SQL, with emphasis on digital citizenship, cybersecurity fundamentals (CIA Triad), and CSTA framework alignment.

## Key Topics

- Python programming
- JavaScript programming
- Karel the Dog
- Tracy the Turtle
- Web design (HTML/CSS)
- Cybersecurity and CIA Triad
- Digital citizenship
- CSTA standards
- Turtle Graphics
- p5.js
- micro:bit
- Game design and Unity
- SQL and databases
- Cryptography
- State-aligned curriculum

## High School Computer Science Courses

- [Game Development in Unity - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/21443/overview): High school Unity game dev with C#, 2D/3D games & VR using MDA framework
- [Introduction to SQL - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/25/overview): Beginner SQL course covering relational databases & data analysis queries
- [Pennsylvania Foundations of Computer Science - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/6361/overview): PA high school CS course with Karel, JavaScript, and CSTA framework
- [Tennessee Computer Science Foundations - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/25729/overview): TN high school CS foundations with HTML, CSS, cybersecurity & cloud computing
- [Illinois Introduction to Computer Science - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/19648/overview): IL high school intro CS course with JavaScript, Karel, and cybersecurity
- [Indiana Computer Science I - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/5639/overview): IN high school CS I with Karel, JavaScript, and cybersecurity basics
- [Tennessee Introduction to Computer Science - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/19781/overview): TN intro CS course with JavaScript, Karel, and CIA Triad cybersecurity
- [Florida Computing Ideas (2019) - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/6378/overview): FL high school year-long CS with Karel, JavaScript & mobile app development

## Middle School Computer Science Courses

- [Mix and Match Middle School Course - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/20485/overview): Customizable middle school modular course with Karel, JavaScript & web design
- [Python Basics with Tracy the Turtle - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/21071/overview): Middle school beginner Python with Tracy Turtle visual programming
- [Python Basics with Tracy the Turtle 2 - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/21069/overview): Middle school Python 2 with Tracy: lists, strings & file I/O fundamentals
- [West Virginia Discovering Computer Science - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/20502/overview): WV middle school intro CS with Karel, p5.js, cryptography & CIA Triad
- [Rhode Island Tech Apps and Coding - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/23375/overview): RI middle school Python, web design, micro:bit & cryptography course
- [Montana Tech Apps and Coding - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/16603/overview): MT middle school Python, web design, micro:bit & CSTA 2 standards course
- [Utah Introduction to Python 2 - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/20333/overview): UT middle school Python 2 with lists, strings, file I/O & Tracy Turtle

## State-Aligned Grade-Level Courses

- [Connecticut Computer Science: 8th Grade - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/25038/overview): CT 8th grade Python programming course with Tracy the Turtle
- [Connecticut Computer Science: 7th Grade - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/25037/overview): CT 7th grade course with Karel, HTML/CSS web design & game design intro
- [Indiana Computer Science: 8th Grade - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/22924/overview): IN 8th grade CS with Karel, game design & digital citizenship standards

## Interdisciplinary and Specialized Courses

- [Coding in Math - Overview](https://codehs.com/course/13419/overview): STEM integration course using Python & Turtle Graphics for math education
